title: Route 9 Small Bay appraisal June 30, 2026
summary: Example Appraisal Group, MAI: as-is market value $12,800,000 as of June 30, 2026 at a 6.00% cap on $768,000 NOI.

evidence.quote: This appraisal of Route 9 Small Bay was prepared by Example Appraisal Group, MAI.
The effective date of value is June 30, 2026.
The date of the report is July 22, 2026.
The interest appraised is the leased fee interest.
The market value of the leased fee interest, as is, is $12,800,000.
A direct capitalization rate of 6.00% was applied to stabilized net operating income of $768,000.
